_comment: Per-harness pass rates recorded from a real CI run. The scientific-audit
job fails if any harness drops below its rate here (see #342).
These are NOT targets. Seven harnesses are below 100% and that debt is
tracked in #106. Raising a number is a reviewable commit; lowering one
should be treated as a bug report, not routine maintenance.
clawbio-finemapping was lowered 95.0 -> 90.0 in PR #423 (SuSiE moved onto
sushie). Neither lost point is a new scientific error, and the rest of the
harness improved: the phantom-credible-set pathology fm_04 targets is gone
(10 sets on the demo locus, 8 of them purity-0, down to the 2 real ones).
The two cases and why they moved:
fm_12 susie_nonconvergence: was harness_error (excluded) on main, now a
scored fail. Its rubric accepts 'a top-level status flag that
downstream callers must consult', which is exactly what the adapter
now returns (converged=False plus a RuntimeWarning, mirroring
susieR::susie_rss). The grader only accepts a raise. Raised upstream.
fm_14 susie_moment_mislabeled: was a pass, now harness_error. Its locus
is z=[5,5,0] under identity LD, so the single credible set contains two
uncorrelated variants, purity 0, and is pruned. PIPs are reported over
surviving sets only (see the SKILL.md gotcha), so the case gets no mu
to score. The case also expects susieR's z-unit r*z moments; sushie
reports standardised effect-size moments. Raised upstream.
Restore 95.0 once either case is regraded upstream.
pharmgx-reporter is temporarily lowered 95.5 -> 90.9 after PR #557 added
DPYD HapB3 (rs75017182). The pinned upstream dpyd_2a_het and dpyd_neg
fixtures omit this marker but still expect determinate phenotypes. Both
now return Indeterminate (incomplete coverage: 3/4 SNPs tested).
The two existing failures (grch37_reference_mismatch and tpmt_compound_het)
are unchanged. This records stale fixture expectations, not a rollback
of the expanded panel or its incomplete-coverage guard.
Restore at least 95.5 when CI pins an upstream revision with corrected
DPYD controls/expectations and a smoke run confirms the recovered passes.
